description:
Hold state and priority in validation projections as their enums instead of stringified values.

## Background

`Projection.state` and `Projection.priority` are strings (`crates/jit/src/domain/projection.rs:64,67`), filled by `serde_plain_state` and `serde_plain_priority` (`:164-181`) through `serde_json::Value`. A schema contract test pins both as `{"type":"string"}` (`projection.rs:409-410`). User `.jit/schemas` validate the serialized values, which do not change.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Projection.state` is a `State` and `Projection.priority` a `Priority`, and the two stringifying helpers are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Serialized projections are byte-identical.
- [hard] REQ-03: The schema contract test asserts the enum schema the typed fields publish.
title: Validation projections hold typed state and priority
